column5: Routed 2026-08-25 at /play/bingo; was a 1024x805 dialog at scale 0.348 (Bet 115.5x18.1). Measured at 375: scale 1, Bet 283x52, bet input 121.2x42, all controls reachable, no horizontal page overflow. Currency toggle was 53.4x28 - under the 44px touch floor, the one control on the page still under it - FIXED in skai-gaming 04cd2a2 (NOT YET DEPLOYED): the trigger drops no-min-size and its hit area now spans the 42px bet field, so the global mobile floor applies; the frame's coin+caret do not move. Everything else on the page already cleared 44. SEPARATELY, and not a layout matter: bingo could not COMPLETE a round on the points rail at all - BingoGame read result.drawnNumbers while that rail returns drawnBalls, so every settled round surfaced as 'Failed to play' after the stake had already been taken (report 50487af9, fixed in the same commit). A 375 sweep measures reachability, not whether the control it reaches works.
